field_evidence.description: Ashford Borough Council describes the Bilsington conservation area as based around the crossroads, a small village with a large conservation area, mainly fields.
field_evidence.source_area_semantics: A conservation area is a planning/heritage designation area. It is source-area context and is not a registered-title/cadastral parcel.
field_evidence.parcel_geometry_limit: This official record page does not provide a target-specific title number, Land Registry INSPIRE ID, cadastral/title polygon, canonical parcel bbox, or registered-title plan for Forge Cottage.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is promoted from conservation-area membership or conservation-area extent.
